community_cards.caveats: Third community card is partly occluded by the robot gripper; rank/suit are uncertain. No fourth or fifth board cards are visible.

held_cards.caveats: Robot hand is not visibly holding a hole card; nearby table cards are not treated as robot-held evidence.

buttons.caveats: White DEALER button is in the opponent's upper table area; yellow BIG BLIND button is near the robot's lower/right chip area. No visible button conflict.

turn.caveats: Small white physical turn button labeled Your Turn is visible near the lower-left player area.

scene_stability.caveats: Only one image was available for comparison. No visible motion blur; chips, cards, and buttons appear settled. Robot arm is static above the table.

robot_behavior.status: hand extended over lower/right robot-side table area near chip area
robot_behavior.caveats: The hand appears to be reaching or possibly contacting/pushing chips. No card or chips are clearly held in the gripper.

showdown.caveats: Opponent and robot hole cards appear face-down. No clear fold, muck, chip collection, outcome action, or readable revealed hole cards are visible.

chips.caveats: Denomination uncertain due to robot hand occlusion; appears possibly brown 100 or green 50.

bets.caveats: Bottom and top inventory chip groups are not counted as bets. Opponent/right betting area is partially occluded, so additional hidden chips are not countable.

inventory.caveats: Inventory counts are approximate and exclude bets, pot, cards, buttons, and table markers.

reasoning_agent.reason: Dedicated reasoning subagent failed with an inherited-model compatibility error; no subagent-backed action recommendation was available.
